notes: The manual is low-resolution; several placements (which stud each cab piece sits on, order of cab pieces, what the clip plates hold) are best guesses.
Wheel arch (lego-60212) has no anti-stud ports in the catalogue, so its join to the brick and the 6187 bar join use null ports.
Wheel and tyre have no usable ports for the wheel-holder join; null ports used on the holder side. Wheels 1-2 go on b2, 3-4 on b3.
Chainsaw blade (b13) and Bar with clip (b14) are held by the clip plates; blade has no ports, so null port used.
Minifigure is not in the parts list and is not modelled.
Lever ports for attachment to the brick are null since the catalogue lists only studs, hinge and bar.
Second curved brick (b22) and the two hinge plates (b20, b21) form the arm; their exact stacking is inferred from steps 10-11.
